test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Our machine is shipped to ten different countries.

options.text: We shipped our machine to ten different countries.
We are shipping our machine to ten different countries.
Someone ship our machine on ten different countries.
We ship our machine to ten different countries.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'We ship our machine to ten different countries.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**. We have to change the sentence into the **active form. **
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present indefinite tense' form. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + is/are + V3 + by + Subject
 
• Active Voice: Subject + V1 + Object.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Passive voice: The ambulance is called by us.
 
• Active voice: We call the ambulance.
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'our machine' and the subject of the given sentence is silent which is 'us' as the correct form of the sentence also can be 'Our machine is shipped** ****to ten different countries** by us.'
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of ‘object’ and ‘subject’ will be interchanged.
 
• Also here, the silent subject 'us' will be changed into 'we.'
 
• The V3 'is shipped' will be changed into V1 'ship.'
 
• The remaining part will not be changed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *We ship our machine to ten different countries.*
